intro.text: Show off your new top row skills. This checkpoint uses the home row and the top row – no keyboard hints.
intro.tip: Reach 90% accuracy and 8 WPM to pass. Breathe and take it steady.

steps.title: Checkpoint, part one
steps.text: we waited for a quiet day; the girls rode their horses to the sea; please write a short story; our first trip was a great day;

steps.title: Checkpoint, part two
steps.text: type at a steady speed; a puppy is a happy pet; the wise old owl sat quietly; you type faster today;
steps.instructions: No hints this time – keep a steady rhythm.
